# Photo Printing Web Application

A Next.js demo application for photo printing services with upload, size selection, and mock payment functionality.

## Features Implemented
✅ Photo upload (up to 5 photos)
✅ Thumbnail display  
✅ Print size selection (4×6, 5×7, 8×10)
✅ Automatic price calculation
✅ Mock payment button
✅ Mobile-friendly responsive design
✅ TypeScript implementation
✅ Tailwind CSS styling

## Technologies Used
- Next.js 15 with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- React Hooks (useState, useRef)

## Quick Start
```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Visit http://localhost:3000 to view the application.
